FIELD.name: ra
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: right ascension (J2000 decimal deg)

FIELD.name: dec
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: declination (J2000 decimal deg)

FIELD.name: err_maj
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Semi-major axis length of the one sigma position uncertainty ellipse

FIELD.name: err_min
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Semi-minor axis length of the one sigma position uncertainty ellipse

FIELD.name: err_ang
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: angle of error ellipse major axis (E of N)

FIELD.name: designation
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: source designation formed from sexigesimal coordinates

FIELD.name: j_m
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: J band selected "default" magnitude

FIELD.name: j_cmsig
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: corrected J band photometric uncertainty

FIELD.name: j_msigcom
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: combined (total) J band photometric uncertainty

FIELD.name: j_snr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: J band "scan" signal-to-noise ratio

FIELD.name: h_m
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: H band selected "default" magnitude

FIELD.name: h_cmsig
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: corrected H band photometric uncertainty

FIELD.name: h_msigcom
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: combined (total) H band photometric uncertainty

FIELD.name: h_snr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: H band "scan" signal-to-noise ratio

FIELD.name: k_m
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: K band selected "default" magnitude

FIELD.name: k_cmsig
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: corrected K band photometric uncertainty

FIELD.name: k_msigcom
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: combined (total) K band photometric uncertainty

FIELD.name: k_snr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: K band "scan" signal-to-noise ratio

FIELD.name: ph_qual
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: flag indicating photometric quality of source

FIELD.name: rd_flg
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: source of JHK "default" mags (AKA "read flag")

FIELD.name: bl_flg
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: indicates # JHK components fit simultaneously to source

FIELD.name: cc_flg
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: indicates JHK artifact contamination and/or confusion

FIELD.name: ndet
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: number of >3-sig. ap. mag measurements, # possible (jjhhkk)

FIELD.name: prox
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: distance in arcsec to nearest catalog point source

FIELD.name: pxpa
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: angle (deg E of N) to nearest catalog point source

FIELD.name: pxcntr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: cntr of nearest catalog point source

FIELD.name: gal_contam
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: flag indicating if src is contaminated by extended source

FIELD.name: mp_flg
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: src is positionally associated with an asteroid, comet, etc

FIELD.name: cntr
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: entry key (counter) number (unique within table)

FIELD.name: hemis
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: hemisphere (N/S) of facility from which src was observed

FIELD.name: xdate
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: observation reference date

FIELD.name: scan
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: scan number (unique within date)

FIELD.name: glon
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: galactic longitude (decimal deg)

FIELD.name: glat
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: galactic latitude (decimal deg)

FIELD.name: x
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: unit sphere x value

FIELD.name: y
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: unit sphere y value

FIELD.name: z
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: unit sphere z value

FIELD.name: x_scan
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: x (cross-scan) position (U-Scan coord.)

FIELD.name: jdate
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: julian date of source measurement to +/- 30 sec

FIELD.name: j_psfchi
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: J band reduced chi-squared goodness-of-fit value

FIELD.name: h_psfchi
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: H band reduced chi-squared goodness-of-fit value

FIELD.name: k_psfchi
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: K band reduced chi-squared goodness-of-fit value

FIELD.name: j_m_stdap
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: J band standard (r=4") aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: j_msig_stdap
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: J band standard (r=4") aperture mag uncertainty

FIELD.name: h_m_stdap
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: H band standard (r=4") aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: h_msig_stdap
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: H band standard (r=4") aperture mag uncertainty

FIELD.name: k_m_stdap
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: K band standard (r=4") aperture magnitude

FIELD.name: k_msig_stdap
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: K band standard (r=4") aperture mag uncertainty

FIELD.name: dist_edge_ns
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: distance to nearest north or south full-coverage scan edge

FIELD.name: dist_edge_ew
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: distance to nearest east or west full-coverage scan edge

FIELD.name: dist_edge_flg
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: flag indicating which edges ([n|s][e|w]) are nearest to src

FIELD.name: dup_src
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: duplicate source extractions flag (overlap areas)

FIELD.name: use_src
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: use source flag -- source is to be used in catalog

FIELD.name: a
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: optical source catalog identifier of closest match within 5"

FIELD.name: dist_opt
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: distance in arcsec relative to associated optical source

FIELD.name: phi_opt
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: position angle relative to optical source (E of N)

FIELD.name: b_m_opt
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: catalog blue mag of associated optical source

FIELD.name: vr_m_opt
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: catalog visual or red mag of associated optical source

FIELD.name: nopt_mchs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: number of optical sources matched to this 2MASS source

FIELD.name: ext_key
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: key to extended source data DB record

FIELD.name: scan_key
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: key to scan data record in the scan information table

FIELD.name: coadd_key
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: key to coadd data record in the atlas image data table

FIELD.name: coadd
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: number of atlas image in which the source falls

FIELD.name: htm20
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: HTM 20 spatial (x,y,z) index key
